rows.text: SPA, under the dateline Makkah 25 Ramadan 1428 / 7 October 2007, reproduces Royal Order A/164 dated 26/9/1428 AH by King Abdullah issuing the executive regulations of the Allegiance Commission Law; its recital cites the Law as issued by Royal Order A/135 of 26/9/1427 AH.
